subject: dipSPADES: RAM limit for SPAdes in Gb or GB?

messages.author: ebff47c4b7852e3a
messages.subject: dipSPADES: RAM limit for SPAdes in Gb or GB?
parts:
I'm starting to use dipSPADES (SPAdes genome assembler v3.11.1) and I noticed that the -m parameter is, according to the option description, specified in Gb (gigabits) - is it correct or is it rather expected that the provided number is gigabytes (GB) of RAM?
Thanks!

messages.author: 71df1ea0682dcc02
messages.subject: Re: dipSPADES: RAM limit for SPAdes in Gb or GB?
parts: I think you have the wrong SpaDES. This is the forum for the R package for Spatial Discrete Event Simulation.
